description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values—categorized as HERO, VICTIM, and VILLAIN—across four political leaning groups: Left bias, Left center bias, Quest. source, and Right bias. The vertical axis represents the normalized proportion of each FOCUS category, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, while the horizontal axis lists the four political leaning categories. Each bar is a stacked column, with segments colored blue for HERO, brown for VICTIM, and light blue for VILLAIN, as indicated in the legend. In the “Left bias” group, HERO accounts for approximately 0.33, VICTIM for 0.14, and VILLAIN for 0.53. In “Left center bias,” HERO is about 0.35, VICTIM is 0.20, and VILLAIN is 0.45. For “Quest. source,” HERO rises to 0.45, VICTIM drops to 0.05, and VILLAIN is 0.50. In “Right bias,” HERO is 0.27, VICTIM is 0.13, and VILLAIN is 0.60. The chart visually emphasizes that VILLAIN is the dominant framing across all groups, particularly in Right bias, while HERO is most prominent in Quest. source. The bars are presented in a fixed left-to-right order without sorting by magnitude, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond color coding.
